inline_comments.body: `RecoveryRequired -> Switching` with a fresh generation has no path that archives or terminalizes the fenced candidate, reassigns the sole candidate pointer, or runs artifact verification, lock, shadow, and canary gates.
inline_comments.suggestion: Define one complete path, preferably terminalizing the fenced candidate and returning to `Stable`/`NoDeployment` before using the ordinary `Staging` pipeline.
